name: Pika 2.5 Keyframe
description: Animate between 2-5 ordered keyframes with Pika 2.5.

seed.description: Seed for reproducible generation. Defaults to a random seed.
seed.title: Seed

images.description: 2-5 ordered keyframe image URLs. Consecutive pairs become transitions.
images.title: Images

prompt.description: Text prompt guiding the motion. Applied to every transition.
prompt.title: Prompt

transition_duration_s.description: Seconds per transition. Over 5 seconds needs exactly 2 keyframes.
transition_duration_s.title: Transition Duration S

negative_prompt.description: Text describing what to avoid in the video.
negative_prompt.title: Negative Prompt
